posts.text:
✨ Someone Else's Success Became My Beginning.
A few days ago, I saw my friend Sanjana Yadav LinkedIn post about being selected as a SheFi Scholar. Instead of comparing myself, I got inspired.
I immediately searched for the program, realized the applications were still open, and decided to give it a shot.
Today, I'm grateful to share that I've been awarded a Full Scholarship for SheFi Season 17! 💜
A huge thank you to Maggie Love, the entire SheFi team, and partners like Solana, Phantom, RootstockCollective, and Decentraland  for creating such an incredible global opportunity.
This experience reminded me that success isn't a competition—it's inspiration. Sometimes, someone else's achievement is exactly what motivates you to chase your own.

Thank you, Sanjana Yadav, for unknowingly inspiring me to apply.
Here's to learning, growing, and supporting each other. 🚀
#SheFi #SheFiScholar #WomenInWeb3 #Blockchain #GrowthMindset #Learning #Community #WomenInTech

Officially, my 3rd semester begins today. 🚀
This month wasn't about mastering every skill—it was about finding the right direction.

So today, as my 3rd semester officially begins, I'm stepping into my grinding era.
 
📌 Placement Prep Log | Day 1
 
💻 DSA (Striver's A2Z DSA + LeetCode) ( Raj Vikramaditya and takeUforward) 
 
 ✅ Solved Search a 2D Matrix
✅ Solved Maximum Total Value
📚 Continued learning Arrays and Binary Search concepts. 
 
🌐 Full Stack Development ( Love Babbar MERN Course)

✅ Completed Lecture 1 & 2
📖 Learned the fundamentals of Full Stack Development and how the web works. 
 
📊 Current LeetCode Progress

✅ 122 Problems Solved
🟢 Easy: 78
🟡 Medium: 39
🔴 Hard: 5

I'm not chasing perfection anymore.
 
I'm chasing consistency.
 
Let's see where showing up every single day takes me.

Here's to Day 1. 💙

#PlacementPreparation #LeetCode #DSA #FullStackDevelopment #MERN #LearningInPublic #SoftwareEngineering #ComputerScience #Consistency

🚀 Another step forward in my AI learning journey!
Today, I'm happy to share that I've successfully completed the "Agentic AI for Beginners" course from Udemy , instructed by Aakriti E-Learning.
As a 2nd-year Computer Science Engineering student, I'm constantly exploring emerging technologies that are shaping the future. Agentic AI is one of the most exciting areas in AI, where intelligent agents can reason, plan, and perform tasks autonomously.
Through this course, I gained a foundational understanding of:
✅ What Agentic AI is and why it matters
✅ AI agents and autonomous workflows
✅ Prompt engineering fundamentals
✅ Real-world applications of AI agents
✅ The future of AI-powered automation
This is just the beginning. My goal is to keep learning, building real-world AI projects, participating in hackathons, and sharing everything I learn with the community.
Every certificate is not just an achievement—it's a reminder that consistent learning creates extraordinary opportunities.
A big thank you to Aakriti E-Learning Academy and Udemy for making this learning experience accessible.
On to the next milestone! 💙
#AgenticAI #ArtificialIntelligence #AI #Udemy #LearningNeverStops #ComputerScience #CSEStudent #TechJourney #PromptEngineering #AIAgents #GenerativeAI #Students #FutureOfAI #NehaGupta

"Soft skills don't get as much attention as technical skills... until you realize they shape every opportunity."
 
When I started my engineering journey, I believed that learning to code was enough.
 
But over time, I realized something important.
 
The best ideas fail if you can't communicate them.
 The strongest technical skills don't shine if you can't collaborate.
 And confidence isn't built only by solving problems—it's built by learning how to work with people.
 
That's why I invested time in improving my Interpersonal Skills.
 
I'm happy to share that I've successfully completed the Interpersonal Skills Microcertificate from the Wadhwani Foundation.
 
This learning strengthened my understanding of:
 ✨ Effective communication
 🤝 Team collaboration
 🎯 Active listening
 💡 Professional relationships
 🌱 Continuous self-improvement
 
Every certificate from Wadhwani Foundation is more than just a document—it's a reminder that growth happens one step at a time.
 
Looking forward to applying these skills in hackathons, projects, internships, and future collaborations.
 
#Learning #InterpersonalSkills #WadhwaniFoundation #EngineeringStudent #ContinuousLearning #CareerGrowth #SoftSkills #StudentJourney #LinkedInLearning

A certificate is just one page. But the learning behind it can change the way you think.
A few days ago, I believed that building a great product was all about technology.
The better the AI.
The smarter the features.
The stronger the innovation.
Then I completed the Customer Centricity course by Wadhwani Foundation 
One lesson stood out:
Customers don't buy features. They buy solutions to their problems.

Now, before thinking:
❌ "What can we build?"
I first ask:
✅ "What problem are we solving?"
✅ "Who are we solving it for?"
✅ "Will this genuinely make someone's life better?"
Technology creates products.
Customer understanding creates impact.
Every course may not teach a new programming language, but sometimes it teaches a new way of thinking—and that's often more valuable.
Happy to add another milestone to my learning journey! 🚀
Thank you, Wadhwani Foundation, for this valuable learning experience.
#LearningNeverStops #CustomerCentricity #WadhwaniFoundation #ProductThinking #Innovation #Hackathon #EngineeringStudent #ArtificialIntelligence #CareerGrowth #StudentDeveloper #ContinuousLearning
